summary: Design role-linked skill maps, assessment rubrics and learning pathways. Explore this practical five-day intermediate course.
lede: Skills-based workforce frameworks connect role tasks to defined skills, proficiency expectations and assessable learning pathways. For HR, talent and learning professionals, this intermediate course develops practical methods to map roles to skills, assess evidence and prioritize capability gaps. Participants also design sequenced learning routes and reporting views using DACUM job analysis, proficiency rubrics and ADDIE.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who define role requirements, assess capability or design employee development. It is designed for people who need to connect the skills their teams use with credible assessment evidence and focused learning routes.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, workforce development, job analysis or learning design is expected. Familiarity with role profiles or employee development planning will help. No coding or programming is required.
